reads_as: skeptical sloth side-eyes two languages, one wrong (X), one right (check)

Right half is a 2x2 verdict grid of icons: top-left a large red X over cell 7 (~x600,y90), top-right a green checkmark circle in cell 8 (~x870,y80), bottom-left the blue/yellow Python logo in cell 11 (~x600,y330), bottom-right the orange Rust/crab (Ferris) icon in cell 12 (~x880,y330).
